reasons.plausibility: SRO-induced variations in fault energy affecting dislocation and twinning behavior are well-established phenomena in multi-component alloys, making the hypothesis scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: A clear comparison between annealed (high SRO) and quenched (low SRO) samples under controlled conditions provides a straightforward experiment that can decisively confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: Isolating the role of SRO on mechanical properties addresses a core challenge in multi-component alloy design and offers a direct path for optimization, making the hypothesis highly relevant and valuable.
